name: Ed Zschau
summary:
Edwin Van Wyck Zschau (; born January 6, 1940) is an American educator who represented California's 12th District in the United States House of Representatives from 1983 to 1987. In 1986, he was the unsuccessful Republican nominee for the U.S. Senate, losing to incumbent Democrat Alan Cranston by a narrow margin.
Zschau briefly re-entered the political arena as the vice presidential running mate to former Colorado Governor Dick Lamm, a Democrat, who challenged Ross Perot for the Reform Party presidential nomination in 1996.
